en.t: Your parents must have been nearly frantic with worry.

units.source_text: 一想到这些，我恨不得现在就把你送回去，

en.t: When I think of that, I almost wish I could send you back right now,
but it is already too late to return you.

units.source_text: 如果你要求寻找亲生父母，那可就没法子了。

en.t: If you ask to search for your birth parents, then there will be nothing I can do.

units.source_text: 不过……果真那样，我这个做母亲的，也许会伤心死了。”

en.t: But... if that really happened, I, as your mother, might die of grief.”
